subject: Helion Health MSA + DPA — hosting evidence, escrow confirmation, and execution checklist
body:
Message 1/7
From: Nadia Khan <procurement@helionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Hassan <counsel@helionhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Helion MSA/DPA — hosting evidence and escrow confirmation

Hi Markus,

We're working through legal signoff for the MSA + Order Form and the DPA. Two asks from our side before we can route to Exec:

1) Can Redwood confirm hosting evidence for the EU region (ISO27001 scope, VPC routing, and a KMS attestation for keys used for customer data)?
2) We need confirmation whether your standard escrow approach (for model artifacts) is acceptable or if Helion needs a limited-scope escrow rider. Our procurement team attached a short scoping matrix — see attached.

Appreciate a short note on evidence items you can provide and any anticipated timing.

Thanks,
Nadia
Nadia Khan
Procurement — Helion Health
procurement@helionhealth.com
Attachment: helion_scoping_matrix.xlsx

---

Message 2/7
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Khan <procurement@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Helion MSA/DPA — hosting evidence and escrow confirmation

Thanks Nadia — received and reviewed the scoping matrix. Quick summary of what we can provide immediately and next steps:

- Evidence we can share today (attestations/stubs): ISO27001 scope statement (PDF stub), KMS key policy export (redacted), VPC region routing diagram (internal diagram PDF stub).
- SCCs/DPA approach: we propose standard SCCs + DPA exhibits (we've applied the EU Commission standard clauses where required). We'll flag any limited deviations in the DPA exhibit.
- Escrow: Redwood's standard escrow covers runtime artifacts and recovery keys. For model artifact escrow, we can offer a limited-scope rider (exec approval required).

Action items from Redwood side:
1) Attach a preliminary SCCs gap log and shipping a redline to the Order Form by EOD Wed (attached: redwood_sccs_gaplog.xlsx).
2) Loop in Legal to confirm the escrow rider path (cc'ing Ben).
3) Propose a short mutual action plan (MAP) — legal review (3 business days), procurement review (2 business days), exec signoff window (up to 5 business days).

If that timing works for Helion, we'll prepare the orderform redline and DPA exhibit.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Legal Ops — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_sccs_gaplog.xlsx

---

Message 3/7
From: Nadia Khan <procurement@helionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Hassan <counsel@helionhealth.com>, Helion Legal <legal@helionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Helion MSA/DPA — hosting evidence and escrow confirmation

Markus — thanks for the quick reply and the gap log. A few clarifications from our counsel:

- The scoping matrix indicates Helion needs a KMS attestation that customer-specific keys are maintained under a Helion-controlled key policy (we accept redaction for sensitive bits).
- For SCCs, counsel prefers us to see the DPA exhibit redline particularly around subprocessors and onward transfers.
- On escrow: we can accept a limited-scope rider; procurement will require a template to pass to our risk team.

I've attached the scoping matrix (filled with our flags) and a short note from counsel. We can do a 30-minute call tomorrow to align if that helps.

Thanks,
Nadia
Attachment: helion_scoping_matrix_filled.xlsx

Message 4/7
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:37:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Helion MSA/DPA — hosting evidence and escrow confirmation

Markus / Ben — quick security inputs from infra:

- KMS: we can export a key policy audit and provide a redacted CMK rotation schedule. If Helion requires Helion-controlled keys, we support a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) onboarding path but that adds approximately 6 business days for provisioning and validation.
- VPC routing: we'll prepare a minimal evidence package: regional egress map, subnet isolation layout, and the CVE/patch cadence for the host fleet during the past 90 days (summary).
- Subprocessors: we keep an updated subprocessor list (managed in our vendor registry). We'll provide the current snapshot and include a 30-day warning clause for changes in the Order Form annex.

If the timeline is tight, recommend the BYOK conversation be scoped to a follow-up SLA addendum and we provide the standard attestation now.

Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Security — Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: kms-policy-export.txt (redacted stub)

---

Message 5/7
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Nadia Khan <procurement@helionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Helion MSA/DPA — hosting evidence and escrow confirmation

Team / Nadia — attaching an Order Form redline (v2) with the following highlights:

- Added an Order Form exhibit summarizing hosting region and fallback routing policy (Section 2.3).
- DPA: tightened processor-subprocessor notification to 30 days and added a transfer-impact addendum placeholder (we'll complete based on Helion's matrix).
- Escrow: proposed clause for limited-scope model artifact rider (Section 7.4) — requires Exec approval.

Nadia: please review the short redlines and confirm whether Helion needs BYOK before sign-off, or if a BYOK SLA addendum post-sign is acceptable.

Attachment: orderform-redline-v2.docx

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Contracts — Redwood Inference

---

Message 6/7
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Khan <procurement@helionhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 14:15:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Helion MSA/DPA — hosting evidence and escrow confirmation

Ben / Team —

This is a pragmatic path. Proposed execution checklist for visibility (we can share this with Helion to keep the timeline tight):

1) Redwood to deliver attestation packet (ISO scope stub, KMS redacted export, VPC map) — target Mon 26 Apr EOD.
2) Ben to finalize Order Form redline and DPA exhibit updates — Wed 28 Apr EOD.
3) Helion to confirm BYOK requirement or accept BYOK SLA addendum — please confirm by Tue 27 Apr 12:00pm CET.
4) Legal/Exec turnaround: if BYOK not required pre-sign, Exec can approve limited-scope escrow rider within 48 hours after procurement signoff.

If Helion needs BYOK pre-sign we push the overall sign date by ~6 business days (provisioning + validation). I'm comfortable approving the limited-scope escrow rider if Procurement confirms standard redline.

I'll prepare a short DocuSign package once we have Helion's confirmation.

Laura Bennett
Chief Legal Officer — Redwood Inference

Related: draft DocuSign package and MAP template will be shared to the Drive link.

---

Message 7/7 (latest)
From: Nadia Khan <procurement@helionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Hassan <counsel@helionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:43:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Helion MSA/DPA — hosting evidence and escrow confirmation

Markus / Laura / Ben —

Thanks — reviewing with counsel now. Two quick notes:

1) Counsel has flagged one minor change to the processor-subprocessor notification language (they want a carve for emergency legal demands). We'll send a one-paragraph counter-proposal today.
2) Procurement can accept the limited-scope escrow rider provided Helion signs the attached LOI and we have the attestation packet. Routing to Exec now — expect DocuSign by Tue 27 Apr.

Attached signed LOI (scanned) for your records. We'll push the BYOK decision to follow-up if Redwood confirms attestation today.

Best,
Nadia Khan
Procurement — Helion Health
Attachment: signed-engagement-loi.pdf
